assignmentHtml.task: Research Маша и Медведь (Masha and the Bear) YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (2) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (3) Operator: Animation Dream Team / Sharifout Ltd. Corporate chain. Who owns Masha and the Bear IP? (4) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (5) Operating location and displayed country. (6) Languages (Russian primary). (7) Primary content category (children's animation). (8) Content supply model: commissioned animation. (9) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Маша и Медведь is #46 with ~55B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. This is the Russian-language main channel for Masha and the Bear. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Маша и Медведь with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Маша и Медведь (Masha and the Bear) — main Russian-language YouTube channel dossier:

(2) Stable channel ID and canonical URL:

  • Channel ID: UCRv76wLBC73jiP7LX4C3l8Q
  • Canonical URL (handle): https://www.youtube.com/@MashaBearRUSSIAN
  • Alternative URL (ID-based): https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRv76wLBC73jiP7LX4C3l8Q
    The English sister channel is @MashaBearEN (UCu59yAFE8fM0sVNTipR4edw), created separately on Sep 17, 2014.

(3) Operator / corporate chain:
The channel is operated by Animaccord LTD, a private animation company founded June 6, 2008, headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus. The IP was created by animator Oleg Kuzovkov (who personally registered character rights) and the series is produced by Animaccord Animation Studio. Per Russian Wikipedia's "Owners and income" section, the brand-licensing company «Маша и Медведь» is majority-owned by the investment fund «РВТ инвест» (belonging to two US companies), with Rodleport Holdings (Cyprus, controlled by UFG fund) holding 25%. The studio itself is owned by Sergey Kuzmin (80%) and producer Dmitry Loveyko (20%). In 2014, rights were formally transferred from the Moscow studio to the Cyprus-based Animaccord LTD. Animaccord manages 13 official Masha and the Bear YouTube channels across languages.
Regarding the hypothesized entities «Animation Dream Team» and «Sharifout Ltd»: extensive searching returned zero publicly verifiable results connecting either name to Masha and the Bear, Animaccord, or any known subsidiary. These may be backend AdSense/operator names not accessible without YouTube Studio credentials. This point remains unverified.

(4) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload:

  • Channel created: May 31, 2011 (Social Blade)
  • Earliest still-public upload: «Маша и Медведь — Первая встреча (Серия 1)» (How They Met, Episode 1), uploaded June 2, 2011, with ~219.6M views. Note: earlier episodes first appeared on the third-party aggregator channel «Get Movies» (e.g., «Recipe for Disaster» uploaded Jan 31, 2012), but those are not on the official channel.

(5) Operating location and displayed country:
The channel is reported as based in Russia (VidIQ metadata). However, the operating corporate entity Animaccord LTD is registered in Limassol, Cyprus since 2014, and Animaccord closed its Moscow production office in 2025, moving full control to Cyprus.

(6) Languages:
Russian is the primary language. The broader channel network spans 13 official localized channels: Russian, English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Hebrew, and Chinese.

(7) Primary content category:
Children's animation — specifically a preschool comedy animated series (Wikipedia classifies it as "preschool comedy"; YouTube category is children/family-oriented animation).

(8) Content supply model:
Commissioned in-house animation. Episodes are produced at Animaccord Animation Studio using 3D CGI; each episode takes approximately 3 months to produce. The studio maintains full vertical control over production, licensing, and distribution.

(9) Representative works:

  • Main series: Маша и Медведь / Masha and the Bear (Seasons 1–8+, 2009–present, 169+ episodes + specials)
  • Most-watched episode: «Маша + каша» / «Recipe for Disaster» (Episode 17) — Guinness World Record for most-watched cartoon on YouTube, ~4.5 billion views; only animated video in YouTube's all-time top 10
  • First episode: «Первая встреча» / «How They Met» (Episode 1)
  • Spin-offs: Masha's Tales (2012/2017), Masha's Spooky Stories (2014/2016), TaDaBoom music-educational project (2019)
  • Specials: Masha's Christmas (2021), ecology special
  • Collective channel network reached 100 billion views worldwide on YouTube by September 2021; five channels earned Diamond Play Buttons
